_comment: Name this file <bucket_name>.json (falls back to <version>.json when bucket_name is absent). Run mode, image type, environment are chosen in the UI. image_name = VSA, mediator_image_name = Mediator. version drives the source COT layout and can be the parent version (e.g. 9.19.1) when patch artifacts live under a parent-version folder. bucket_name is the destination-side patch identifier used for GCNV/<bucket_name>/... folders (falls back to version when omitted). Optional: vlm_worker_path, vlm_worker_tag for VLM Worker Image Push workflow.
